outer: for (let i = (() => { for (let j = 0; j < 1; j++) {} return 0; })(); i < 2; i = i + "s") {
  continue outer;
}
class Animal { name = 'a'; }
class Dog extends Animal {
  override toString(): string { return `Dog(${this.name})`; }
  override valueOf(): number { return 1; }
  override missing(): void {}
  static override bind(): any { return 1; }
}
console.log(String(new Dog()));
